hints.title: Movement of Ones
hints.text: Every '1' must pass through all zeros situated to its left.

hints.title: Collision Delays
hints.text: If a '1' catches up to another '1' immediately ahead of it, it experiences a 1-second delay.

hints.title: Running Seconds Calculation
hints.text: Track preceding zeros. For each '1', if zeros > 0, seconds = max(seconds + 1, zeros).

hints.title: Linear Seconds Accumulator Implementation

complexity.notes: Single pass tracking zero count and arrival timestamps.
complexity.whyNaiveFails: Simulating second by second substring replacements takes O(n^2) worst case.
complexity.interviewerExpectation: Solves without simulation using preceding zero accumulation and collision delays.
